title: The History and Future of Social Technologies

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow how a familiar institution combines records, roles, incentives, and enforceable expectations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full chronology supplies comparisons that a catalogue of inventions would leave disconnected.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It helps readers ask which rules must change when a powerful new tool arrives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to see the revisable social arrangements inside the technologies you already depend on.
